objective: Improve cold and warm module-loader performance on frozen ESM and TypeScript graph shapes derived from bench/module-loader. Only src/resolver/** is mutable; exact exports and side effects, focused upstream resolver tests, and peak RSS no more than baseline +2% are hard gates.

hardGates: 80 focused upstream resolver tests pass (plus 2 upstream skips and 1 todo; one uid-sensitive auto-install permission case is excluded from the unprivileged test runner)
exact canonical export SHA-256 for every cold and warm observation
